definition.def: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.
examples: The team failed to qualify for the African Nations Cup finals.
He had lost his place in the England team.

definition.def: You can refer to any group of people who work together as a team.
examples: Each specialist consultant has a team of doctors under her. [+ of]

definition.def: If you team up with someone, you join them in order to work together for a particular purpose. You can also say that two people or groups team up.
examples: I teamed up with a photographer who took me round central London for a two-hour picture session. [VERB PARTICLE + with]
Recently a friend suggested that we team up for a working holiday in Europe in the summer. [VERB PARTICLE]
